plain_what: Your average blood sugar over the last 3 months.
plain_low: Sugar may be running low — worth discussing with the doctor.
plain_high: Sugar has been high over months. This is the main number doctors track for diabetes.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: Blood sugar measured on an empty stomach.
plain_low: Sugar dropped low — can cause dizziness or weakness.
plain_high: Sugar is high on an empty stomach — a common early sign of diabetes.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: Blood sugar about 2 hours after eating.
plain_low: Sugar dropped low after eating.
plain_high: Sugar stays high after meals.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: Blood sugar at a random time.
plain_low: Sugar is low.
plain_high: Sugar is high.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: The part of blood that carries oxygen around your body.
plain_low: Low hemoglobin (anaemia) — often causes tiredness, weakness and pale skin. Very common, usually treatable with diet or iron.
plain_high: Higher than usual — the doctor may want to check why.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: White blood cells — your body's defence against infection.
plain_low: Lower defence cells than usual.
plain_high: Often rises when the body is fighting an infection.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: Cells that help blood clot and stop bleeding.
plain_low: Low platelets — bleeding or bruising can happen more easily. Doctors watch this closely in dengue.
plain_high: Higher than usual.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: Total fat circulating in your blood.
plain_high: High cholesterol raises the long-term risk to the heart.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: The 'bad' cholesterol that can block arteries.
plain_high: High bad cholesterol — diet, exercise or medicine may be advised.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: The 'good' cholesterol that protects the heart.
plain_low: Low protective cholesterol — exercise usually helps raise it.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: Another type of fat in the blood, linked to diet and sugar.
plain_high: High — often improves with less sugar, less fried food and more activity.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: A waste product your kidneys filter out — it shows how kidneys are working.
plain_low: Lower than usual, generally not a concern.
plain_high: Raised creatinine can mean the kidneys are under strain. Worth asking the doctor about.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: Another kidney waste product.
plain_low: Low.
plain_high: Raised — kidneys may be under strain or you may be dehydrated.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: A waste product that can collect in joints.
plain_low: Low.
plain_high: High uric acid can cause gout — sudden painful swelling, often in the big toe.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: A liver enzyme — shows how the liver is doing.
plain_high: Raised liver enzyme. Common causes include fatty liver, alcohol or medicines.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: Another liver enzyme.
plain_high: Raised liver enzyme — the doctor will look at this with other liver tests.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: A yellow pigment the liver clears out.
plain_high: High bilirubin can cause yellowing of eyes or skin (jaundice).
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: The hormone that controls your thyroid — your body's energy thermostat.
plain_low: Low TSH usually means an overactive thyroid — can cause weight loss, fast heartbeat, anxiety.
plain_high: High TSH usually means an underactive thyroid — can cause tiredness, weight gain and feeling cold. Very common and easily treated.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: The sunshine vitamin — keeps bones and muscles strong.
plain_low: Low Vitamin D is extremely common in India. It often causes tiredness, body aches, bone or joint pain and weak muscles. Usually corrected with supplements and some sunlight — ask your doctor.
plain_high: Higher than needed — usually from taking too many supplements.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: A vitamin your nerves and blood need — mostly from dairy, eggs and meat.
plain_low: Low B12 can cause tiredness, tingling in hands or feet, and poor memory. Common in vegetarian diets and easily treated.
plain_high: Higher than usual, generally from supplements.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: The upper blood pressure number — pressure when the heart beats.
plain_low: Low blood pressure — can cause dizziness on standing.
plain_high: Raised blood pressure. Sustained high BP strains the heart over years.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: The lower blood pressure number — pressure when the heart rests.
plain_low: Low.
plain_high: Raised blood pressure — worth monitoring regularly.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: How many times the heart beats per minute.
plain_low: Slower than usual.
plain_high: Faster than usual.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: Body weight.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: Weight compared to height.
plain_low: Underweight.
plain_high: Above the healthy range — raises risk of diabetes and heart problems.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: A general sign of inflammation in the body.
plain_high: Raised — the body may be fighting inflammation or infection somewhere.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: A marker that rises with inflammation or infection.
plain_high: Raised inflammation marker.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: The mineral that keeps bones and muscles working.
plain_low: Low calcium can cause cramps and tingling.
plain_high: High.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: A salt that balances body fluids.
plain_low: Low sodium can cause weakness and confusion.
plain_high: High.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: A mineral the heart and muscles need.
plain_low: Low potassium can cause weakness and cramps.
plain_high: High potassium can affect the heart — doctors take this seriously.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: How much iron your body has stored up.
plain_low: Low iron stores — the usual reason behind anaemia and constant tiredness.
plain_high: High iron stores.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: Iron circulating in the blood.
plain_low: Low iron.
plain_high: High iron.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)

plain_what: An estimate of how well the kidneys filter blood.
plain_low: Lower filtering rate — the doctor will want to look at kidney health.
source: IM Smrti v1 (adult generic - NEEDS REVIEW)
